notes.calibration: R5-H5: per question, isotonic (sklearn, out_of_bounds=clip) fitted on val-repo raw answers vs `iterated`, applied to test. R5-H3 verdicts: run-3 rule unchanged — default gate policy (always_human_paths cleared), shipped calibration_<model>_v2.json maps for the four non-primary questions where they exist (jev, haiku), and needs_human_review refit by isotonic on val repos vs `rejected` (report_run3._calibrate_primary). jev/haiku/rules use their run-3 v2 predictions (as run 4). pplx/pplx-flash have no shipped maps, so their four non-primary v2 answers are used uncalibrated; their needs_human_review is refit vs `rejected` on their run-5 v3 val answers; the five new v3 questions are not in the policy and do not affect verdicts.
notes.stack: Stack: features = the raw answers to the ten v3 questions (rows with all ten present), StandardScaler + L2 logistic regression (C=1, lbfgs) fitted on val repos vs `iterated`. Pruning (val only): marginal gain of q = pooled out-of-fold AUC of the 10-question stack minus that of the stack without q, 5-fold stratified CV within val (seed 5). Only the five questions new in v3 are prunable; gains are reported for all ten. Pruned questions are dropped for the stack only.
notes.scale: R5-H6 applies the R3-H5 computation: ×100 p99 vs the model's in-run p99 (v3 rows, val+test) + 200 ms, and 0 errors. The in-run pplx calls ran at concurrency 2 with the adapter's 429 retry on (as run 4), so `pass_vs_x1` — the same bar against the retry-off ×1 load-test p99 — is reported alongside. A load test whose summary does not show retry_429 = 0 is invalid for R5-H6.
